title: Plan Before You Trade: Inference-Time Optimization for RL Trading Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.12653v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents for portfolio management are typically trained and deployed as static policies, with no mechanism for policy adjustments using price forecasts at inference time. We propose FinPILOT (Financial Plugin Inference-time Learning for Optimal Trading), a plugin inference-time policy optimization framework inspired by Model Predictive Control (MPC). Under the price-taker assumption, portfolio actions do not affect future market prices, allowing a multi-step price forecaster to provide imagined market trajectories without iterative action-conditioned rollouts. At each decision step, FinPILOT uses the forecaster's predicted price trajectory to construct an allocation-based imagined return objective and optimizes the pretrained policy at inference time before executing one step of the trade. translated_title: 先规划后交易：强化学习交易智能体的推理时优化
translated_abstract: 用于投资组合管理的强化学习智能体通常以静态策略的形式进行训练和部署，缺乏在推理时利用价格预测对策略进行调整的机制。我们提出了FinPILOT（Financial Plugin Inference-time Learning for Optimal Trading，金融插件推理时学习最优交易），这是一个受模型预测控制（MPC）启发的插件式推理时策略优化框架。在价格接受者假设下，投资组合动作不会影响未来市场价格，这使得多步价格预测器能够提供想象的市场轨迹，而无需迭代式的动作条件推演。在每个决策步骤，FinPILOT利用预测器预测的价格轨迹构建基于配置的想象收益目标，并在执行一步交易之前在推理时对预训练策略进行优化。我们的框架与任何预训练策略兼容，并利用预测器的预测对策略进行调整，而无需……
tldr: 提出了受模型预测控制启发的FinPILOT框架，利用多步价格预测在推理时对任意预训练的强化学习交易策略进行优化，实现“先规划、后交易”的策略自适应调整。
en_tdlr: FinPILOT is an MPC-inspired plugin framework that optimizes any pretrained RL trading policy at inference time using multi-step price forecasts, enabling "plan before you trade" policy adaptation.
